title: QuantiFarm testcase data
description: Data collected in a QuantiFarm testcase to assess the functioning and performance of one or more DATS

testcaseNumber.description: The unique number of the QuantiFarm testcase

testcaseLeader.description: The name of the leader of the QuantiFarm testcase

cultivationType.description: The type of agricultural cultivation that is executed in the QuantiFarm testcase

datsInformation.description: List of the DATSs being applied in the QuantiFarm testcase

items.description: Generic information of a DATS being applied in the QuantiFarm testcase

yearlyAssessmentInformation.description: List of years with one or more parcel comparisons and market information

items.description: Assessment information with parcel comparisons and market information for a single year

threeYearAverages.description: List of three year averages of the main impact parameters that indicate how well the DATSs perform with respect to not using the DATSs

items.description: A three year average impact parameter that indicates how well the DATSs perform with respect to not using the DATSs
